deterministicFindings.message: Action "generatePostIncidentReviewReport" verifies PostIncidentReview.completedAt, but its effect never says that property changes.
Action "submitRegulatoryNotification" verifies RegulatoryNotification.notificationId, but its effect never says that property changes.
MonitoringSystem --generates--> Alert looks like the inverse of Alert --originatedFrom--> MonitoringSystem. The profile is one directed relationship per real-world connection, never also its inverse.

llmFindings.subject: canNotifyStakeholders / notifyStakeholders
llmFindings.message: The rule requires Stakeholder Communication to already be sent to at least one Business Service Owner or Product Manager before sending, but the action's effect is what sends the communication and records recipients.

llmFindings.subject: canGeneratePostIncidentReview / generatePostIncidentReviewReport
llmFindings.message: The rule is written against Incident state and Incident-to-PostIncidentReview relationship, but the action input is PostIncidentReview, so the precondition cannot be evaluated from the action input class alone.

llmFindings.subject: regulatoryNotificationRequired / submitRegulatoryNotification
llmFindings.message: The rule is defined from Materiality Assessment status and outcome, but the action input is RegulatoryNotification and no relationship from RegulatoryNotification back to MaterialityAssessment exists to make that precondition usable on the action input.
